notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Rampaging Baloths.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
